answer: Prompt echo detection binds each agent’s reply to the published challenge text by requiring verbatim overlap checks. Each responder stakes on its submitted echo, and any validator can slash a reply that cannot reproduce the locked tundra challenge phrase. A forger must stake every fake identity separately, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand stakes rather than one. Honest clusters show shared jetty phrasing that mirror the original, while farms cannot reproduce it without holding real copies. Attack cost scales with identity count, pricing sybils out.
